## Minimal Elephant (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
Variant elephant  
N Small animal  
**Init** +3; **Senses** low-light vision, scent; Perception +21  


**Defense**


**AC** 17, touch 14, flat-footed 14 (+3 Dex, +3 natural, +1 size)  
**hp** 82 (11d8+33)  
**Fort** +11, **Ref** +10, **Will** +6  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft.  
**Melee** gore +14 (1d4+4), slam +13 (1d4+4)  
**Special Attacks** trample (1d4+6, DC 23)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 18, **Dex** 16, **Con** 14, **Int** 2, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 7  
**Base Atk** +8; **CMB** +11 (+13 bull rush); **CMD** 24 (26 vs. bull rush, 28 vs. trip)  
**Feats** [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Great Fortitude, Improved Bull Rush, Iron Will, Skill Focus (Perception), [Weapon Focus (gore)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Endurance is part of Toughness; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (gore).*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +4 (+8 to jump), Perception +21  
Languages—  


**Ecology**


**Environment** warm plains  
**Organization** solitary or herd (6–30)  
**Treasure** none
